Coram : R.V. RAVEENDRAN*, K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: ss. 7 and 11 - Government contracts - Tender - Allegation of arbitrariness A B in tender process - Aggrieved bidder filed application for C referring matter to arbitration - Held: On facts, documents show that arbitration clause was applicable only to order and not in regard to any dispute to the tender or bid or non-placing of purchase order - Thus, arbitration clause did not exist in regard to tender D stage dispute or pre-contract differences, at a stage when there was no privily of contract - Since a purchase order was not placed, there
Decision Date : 22-01-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 868/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
